items.title: Louis Armstrong: Jazz Casual Interview, 1964-07-10
items.q: The transcript only shows the interviewer (Ralph Gleason) introducing the interviewee (Louis Armstrong). There is no evidence in the text that Louis Armstrong personally knew, met, or had a professional relationship with Ralph Gleason.

ctx.x: Song Song This is Jazz Casual, I'm Ralph Gleason, and that voice and that music is the voice and

music of jazz as number one ambassador to the world, Louis Armstrong, who is with us today to talk about some of his music. Louis, welcome to Jazz Casual. Thank you very much.
